AwkBeats Prep Station

Released (desktop installers, v1.1.1)

Solo developer

Offline desktop catalog that imports beats, measures BPM and key on the machine, and writes the tags back into the audio files.

A desktop app for preparing a beat catalog before it goes to the store. It imports WAV, MP3, AIFF, and FLAC files or whole folders, detects tempo and musical key locally, picks up cover art that sits next to each file, and writes the metadata back into the audio. Nothing is uploaded; the library is a JSON file in the app-data folder. Built with Electron, React, and TypeScript, with installers published through GitHub Actions releases.

Stack

  • Electron
  • React
  • TypeScript
  • GitHub Actions
